title: Configuration system: btv-config.yaml
description: Implement pkg/config/config.go. Read .beats/btv-config.yaml with settings for: attention windows, alert thresholds, agent impetus patterns, inference confidence threshold. Sensible defaults if no config file.

title: Ripeness scorer: calculate beat readiness for action
description: Implement pkg/ripeness scoring 0.0-1.0 based on: age factor (0.2), revisit factor (0.25), connection factor (0.25), action language detection (0.2), completeness (0.1). Tiers: Fresh <0.3, Maturing 0.3-0.6, Ripe 0.6-0.8, Overripe >0.8.

title: Migration script: v0.1 to v0.2 first-run data enrichment
description: On first v0.2 run: create cache, auto-classify all beats, extract entities, calculate ripeness scores, check Ollama availability. Store in .beats/btv-cache.json. Include progress indicator for large beat sets.

title: Updated help system with v0.3 keybindings and concepts
description: Update help overlay to document all v0.3 views and keybindings. Add sections: Attention Dashboard, Drift View, Heartbeat View. Explain core concepts briefly: activation, drift, crystallization, divergence.

title: Extended data model: Taxonomy, Entity, Cluster, Chain, Cache types
description: Add pkg/model types for v0.2: Taxonomy (Channel + Source enums), Entity (with EntityType), Cluster, Chain, Cache structure, ViewStat. These are computed fields stored in cache, not source JSONL.

title: Add README.md with install/usage instructions
Taxonomy classifier: auto-classify beats by Channel and Source
description: Implement pkg/taxonomy with pattern-based classification. Detect Channel (coaching/research/discovery/development/reflection/reference/milestone) and Source (conversation/web/twitter/github/book/session/internal) from impetus label and content. Goal: 0% Manual entry after classification.

title: Alert store: persistence and seen/unseen tracking
description: Implement pkg/alert/store.go. Store alerts in cache. Track SeenAt timestamp. Alerts auto-expire after 7 days. Methods: Add, MarkSeen, GetUnseen, GetAll, Prune.

title: Content similarity computation for crystallization
description: Implement pkg/inference/similarity.go. Compute similarity between beat content and bead title+description. TF-IDF based (no external deps). Return similarity score 0.0-1.0. Optional: use embeddings if Ollama available.

title: Cache persistence layer
description: Implement .beats/btv-cache.json read/write. Include version tracking, source hash for invalidation, and atomic writes. Cache stores taxonomies, entities, ripeness scores, clusters, chains, and view stats.

title: Divergence analyzer: human vs agent attention patterns
description: Implement pkg/divergence/analyzer.go. Compare human and agent capture patterns over time window. Identify HumanOnly topics, AgentOnly topics, Amplified (both capture). DivergenceReport struct with all categories and counts.

title: Robot commands: taxonomy, ripeness, entities
description: Add robot commands: --robot-taxonomy-stats, --robot-set-taxonomy, --robot-ripeness, --robot-ripe, --robot-entities, --robot-entity-beats. JSON input/output for AI agent integration.

title: Cache v0.3 extensions: AttentionState, Crystallizations, Alerts
description: Extend cache structure with AttentionState (activations, drift, orientation, divergence), Crystallizations array, Alerts array, LastDivergenceAt. Update cache version, handle migration from v0.2 cache.

title: Ollama integration for embeddings
description: Implement pkg/cluster/ollama.go wrapper. Check availability gracefully. Use nomic-embed-text model. Cache embeddings by beat ID. Graceful degradation: skip clustering if Ollama unavailable, show message suggesting install.

title: Robot commands: inference (--robot-crystallizations, --robot-crystallization, --robot-infer)
description: Add robot commands for crystallization inference. --robot-crystallizations lists all inferred connections. --robot-crystallization <bead> shows beats for specific bead. --robot-infer forces inference run and returns results.

title: robot-help: JSON schema of robot commands
CLI entry point with robot flags in cmd/btv/main.go
Project picker and cycling (p/P keys)
Loader: discover projects and load beats.jsonl in pkg/loader/loader.go
Lipgloss styles and theming in pkg/ui/styles.go
Add MIT LICENSE file
UI: Make Attention Dashboard the default view
description: Change btv default from list view to Attention Dashboard. Update keybindings: A for dashboard (current), L for list (was default). Update help text. Dashboard should be the entry point showing attention state.

title: robot-list: JSON output of beats with project filter
Dormancy and emergence detection
description: Implement pkg/attention/dormancy.go and emergence.go. Dormancy: clusters with ripe beats but no activity for threshold (30 days). Emergence: beats not matching existing clusters, potential new patterns forming. Both feed into alerts.

title: Cache rebuild command and invalidation logic
description: Implement --rebuild-cache flag. Auto-invalidate when beats.jsonl hash changes or cache version mismatches binary. Show rebuild progress for large datasets.

title: Help overlay with keybindings
View stats tracking: record beat views for ripeness calculation
description: Track ViewCount and LastViewedAt for each beat viewed in btv. Store in cache. Update ripeness scores on cache rebuild. Used for revisit factor in ripeness scoring.

title: Alert detector: threshold-based alert generation
description: Implement pkg/alert/detector.go. Generate alerts when thresholds crossed: Activation (3+ in 72h), Emergence (new pattern), Dormancy (30 days inactive), Divergence (agent 3+ human 0), Crystallization (new inference). Run on cache rebuild.

title: Activation detection: burst and reactivation signals
description: Implement pkg/attention/activation.go. Detect activations: Burst (3+ beats in 72h window), Reactivation (dormant cluster waking), Emergent (new pattern). Return Activation structs with type, beat count, window, prior activity for comparison.

title: Robot commands: attention (--robot-attention, --robot-activating, --robot-drift, --robot-orientation, --robot-heartbeat)
description: Add robot commands for attention analysis. --robot-attention returns full AttentionState. --robot-activating returns current activations. --robot-drift --days N returns drift report. --robot-orientation returns summary. --robot-heartbeat --days N returns rhythm data.

title: Quick capture mode: minimal UI for rapid beat entry
description: Implement btv --capture mode. Single text field with channel/source dropdowns. Keyboard-first: type, tab, enter. Auto-impetus detection. Support piped input. Exit after save.

title: Responsive layout system with breakpoints
description: Implement responsive breakpoints: Compact(<60), Normal(100), Wide(140), UltraWide(180). Show/hide sidebars based on width. Ensure all views work at minimum 60 cols.

title: Theme clustering engine with k-means
description: Implement pkg/cluster with k-means clustering on embeddings. Auto-generate cluster names from keywords. Calculate cluster ripeness (aggregate of member beats). Store clusters in cache. Default k=8, configurable.

title: Robot commands: alerts (--robot-alerts, --robot-dismiss)
description: Add robot commands for alerts. --robot-alerts returns all alerts. --robot-alerts --unseen returns only unseen. --robot-dismiss <alert-id> marks alert as seen. JSON output for agent integration.

title: UI: Faceted navigation sidebar for Channel and Source filtering
description: Add toggleable left sidebar showing Channel and Source facets with counts. Click to filter. Keys: f toggle, 1-7 quick channel filter, ! clear. Responsive: hide on narrow terminals.

title: Heartbeat analysis: temporal rhythm of captures
description: Implement pkg/attention/heartbeat.go. Analyze capture rhythm over configurable window (default 90 days). Compute daily density, identify bursts and gaps, current rate vs average, longest gap. Data for heartbeat visualization.

title: Entity extractor: auto-extract people, tools, concepts from beats
description: Implement pkg/entity extraction using pattern matching and known dictionaries. Extract EntityPerson, EntityTool, EntityConcept, EntityProject, EntityOrganization. Build entity index mapping entity name to beat IDs.

title: Robot commands: divergence (--robot-divergence, --robot-blindspots, --robot-agent-beats)
description: Add robot commands for divergence analysis. --robot-divergence returns full DivergenceReport. --robot-blindspots returns agent-only topics. --robot-agent-beats lists beats classified as agent-captured.

title: Split view layout with adaptive width thresholds
Agent beat classifier: identify human vs agent captures
description: Implement pkg/divergence/classifier.go. Classify beats as human or agent based on impetus patterns (droid-session, factory, agent) or explicit metadata. Configurable patterns in btv-config.yaml.

title: robot-show: JSON single beat detail
UI: Timeline view with density visualization
description: Implement timeline view showing beats over time. Dot density indicates activity. Support zoom levels (day/week/month/quarter). Keys: t toggle, arrows navigate, z zoom, c channel coloring, Enter select date. Show gaps in activity.

title: Action: convert beat to bead (b key)
description: Implement b key to convert selected beat to bead. Shell out to bd create with beat content as description. Pre-fill title from first line or generate. Support converting entire cluster to epic.

title: Stale beat detection and review mode
description: Detect stale beats: >30 days old, never/not-recently viewed, no linked beads, not in chain. Review mode with batch actions: keep/archive/convert/chain/delete. Keys: S enter review, k/a/b/c/d actions.

title: UI: Attention Dashboard view (new default)
description: Implement pkg/ui/views/dashboard.go. New primary view showing: Now Activating, Attention Drift, Crystallizing (inferred), Emerging, Agent Divergence, Dormant. Sections navigable with j/k, Enter to expand, arrow to drill into cluster.

title: Beat chains: explicit beat sequences for thinking threads
description: Implement pkg/chain CRUD. Chain has name, ordered beat IDs, aggregate ripeness. Keys: c add to chain, x remove, [ ] navigate within chain. Show chain membership in detail view.

title: Search input component with real-time filtering
Robot commands: timeline, clusters, chains
description: Add robot commands: --robot-timeline, --robot-gaps, --robot-cluster, --robot-clusters, --robot-similar, --robot-chains, --robot-create-chain, --robot-chain-add. JSON I/O.

title: Beads integration: read issues.jsonl for crystallization inference
description: Implement pkg/inference/beads.go. Read-only access to .beads/issues.jsonl. Parse into minimal Bead struct (ID, Title, Description, CreatedAt, ClosedAt). Discover beads dir by walking up from beats dir. Handle missing beads gracefully.

title: Clipboard yank for beat ID and content (y/Y keys)
Add GitHub CI workflow
UI: Alert banner component
description: Implement alert banner shown at top of TUI when unseen alerts exist. Shows count and preview of top alerts. Keys: x dismiss, a view all. Banner appears in all views, not just dashboard.

title: Updated help system with all v0.2 keybindings
description: Rewrite help overlay to document all v0.2 keybindings organized by category: Global, Navigation, Views, Filtering, Actions. Include brief feature explanations.

title: Crystallization inference algorithm
description: Implement pkg/inference/crystallization.go. For each bead, find likely source beats via: content similarity, temporal proximity (beats before bead creation), entity overlap, session correlation. Compute confidence score, threshold at 0.6 to surface.

title: Robot command: --robot-stale for maintenance automation
description: Add --robot-stale to list beats needing attention. Include staleness reason and suggested action. Used by agents for automated beat hygiene.

title: UI: Entity sidebar with navigation by entity
description: Add toggleable entity sidebar showing People/Tools/Concepts with beat counts. Click entity to filter. Keys: e toggle, E entity search. Group by EntityType with collapsible sections.

title: Attention state computation on startup
description: Wire up attention analysis to run on btv startup. Compute all attention metrics, store in cache. Recompute when cache stale (beats.jsonl changed). Show computation progress for large datasets. Target: <500ms for 300 beats.

title: Fix go.mod module path for go install compatibility
Attention stream modeling: temporal flow of captures
description: Implement pkg/attention/stream.go. Model the attention stream as sequence of beats over time. Compute flow rate, composition by cluster/source/channel, time-windowed aggregations. Foundation for all attention analysis.

title: Orientation summary: where attention is pointing
description: Implement pkg/attention/orientation.go. Compute OrientationSummary: top topics weighted by recency+volume, growing topics, crystallizing topics, emerging topics. Single struct summarizing attention direction.

title: Beat list component with bubbles/list in pkg/ui/list.go
Fix default root path - use ~/.beats or cwd instead of ~/werk
Beat detail viewport in pkg/ui/detail.go
Drift analysis: attention shifts over time windows
description: Implement pkg/attention/drift.go. Compare attention patterns across configurable windows (default 30 days). Categorize clusters as Rising/Stable/Fading/Emerged/Vanished with change percentages. DriftReport struct with all categories.

title: Core types: Beat and Project structs in pkg/model/types.go
Document relationship to beats in README
Remove personal names from entity dictionary
Add install.sh script
Integration test: attention analysis accuracy
description: Manual verification that attention analysis matches intuition. Test activations against felt sense of what's alive. Test drift against known attention shifts. Test crystallization inference accuracy (<20% false positive). Document findings.

title: robot-search: JSON search results
TUI model: bubbletea model with focus states in pkg/ui/model.go
UI: Heartbeat/rhythm visualization view
description: Implement pkg/ui/views/heartbeat.go. ASCII visualization of capture density over time. Show daily bars, mark bursts and gaps, display current rate vs average. Key: H to toggle. Responsive to terminal width.

title: Blind spot detection: what agents notice that you don't
description: Implement pkg/divergence/blindspot.go. Identify topics where agents have 3+ captures and human has 0. These are potential blind spots. Rank by agent capture volume. Include in DivergenceReport.BlindSpots.

title: UI: Drift detail view
description: Implement pkg/ui/views/drift.go. Detailed drift analysis view showing Rising/Stable/Fading/Emerged/Vanished categories with full lists. Key: D to toggle. Allow drilling into specific clusters from drift items.

title: UI: Ripeness indicators and sort-by-ripeness
description: Show ripeness emoji (fresh/maturing/ripe/overripe) in list view. Add R key to sort by ripeness descending. Show ripeness score and tier in detail view. Top ripest beats should surface actionable items.

title: UI: Cluster view with expandable theme groups
description: Implement cluster view showing themed groups. Collapsible clusters with preview beats. Show cluster ripeness. Keys: C toggle, Enter expand/collapse, n rename, m merge clusters, b create bead from cluster.
